name: Jobs Ready for Delivery
query:
select
	cwo.name as "Job:Link/Coach Work Order:140",
	cwo.customer_name as "Customer::180",
	v.vehicle_name as "Vehicle::130",
	cwo.expected_delivery_date as "Promised Delivery:Date:130",
	cwo.total_amount as "Amount:Currency:120",
	cwo.sales_invoice as "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
	si.outstanding_amount as "To Collect:Currency:120"
from `tabCoach Work Order` cwo
left join `tabCoach Work Vehicle` v on v.name = cwo.vehicle
left join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = cwo.sales_invoice and si.docstatus = 1
where cwo.status = 'Open' and cwo.stage = 'Ready'
order by cwo.expected_delivery_date asc
